intro.zh: 适用于 SWE / PM / DS 等岗位。大厂 8 月开放，10 月前投完最稳妥。
intro.en: For SWE / PM / DS roles. Big tech opens in August; applying before October is safest.

tip.zh: 校友内推的价值主要在跳过简历初筛。先把简历改到位再找内推人，一次成功率更高。
tip.en: Referrals mostly get you past the resume screen. Polish the resume first, then ask — one clean shot beats three rushed ones.

detail.zh: LeetCode 中等题 150 道左右；把课程项目 / 实习写成可讲 5 分钟的故事。
detail.en: ~150 medium LeetCode problems; turn class projects / internships into 5-minute stories.

detail.zh: Google / Meta / Microsoft 校招陆续开放，找校友内推。
detail.en: Google / Meta / Microsoft new-grad roles open; line up alumni referrals.

detail.zh: 在线测评通常 3–7 天内完成；同时保持每周 2 次 mock。
detail.en: Finish online assessments within 3–7 days; keep two mocks a week.

detail.zh: 4–5 轮，包含系统设计（硕士）与行为面。
detail.en: 4–5 rounds incl. system design (MS) and behavioral.

detail.zh: 拿到第一个 offer 后可请校友帮忙看 package。
detail.en: Once you have an offer, ask alumni to sanity-check the package.

detail.zh: 大厂 headcount 释放，初创公司集中招人。
detail.en: Big-tech backfills and startups hire heavily.

intro.zh: 投行暑期实习是大三上学期就要投的；咨询校招集中在 9–10 月。
intro.en: IB summer analyst applications open in junior fall; consulting full-time recruiting peaks Sep–Oct.

tip.zh: 投行看 networking 与 timeline，咨询看 case。两条线都需要至少 10 次以上 mock。
tip.en: Banking is about networking and timing; consulting is about the case. Both need 10+ mocks.

detail.zh: 校友 coffee chat 每周 2–3 个，建立自己的联系人表。
detail.en: 2–3 alumni coffee chats a week; keep a contact tracker.

detail.zh: HireVue + superday，进度非常快，通常 4 月前结束。
detail.en: HireVue then superday; most spots fill before April.

detail.zh: MBB 网申，准备 case 与 PEI/行为面。
detail.en: MBB applications; prep cases and PEI/behaviorals.

detail.zh: 两轮各 2–3 个 case。学联组织 case 小组每周练习。
detail.en: Two rounds, 2–3 cases each. ACSSY case groups practice weekly.

detail.zh: 暑期实习 return offer 通常 8–9 月给出；没拿到的在此阶段补投。
detail.en: Return offers usually arrive Aug–Sep; those without apply to accelerated full-time processes.

title.zh: 国内秋招（互联网 / 金融）

intro.zh: 海外毕业生也要按国内秋招节奏走：7–8 月提前批，9–10 月正式批，次年春招补录。
intro.en: Overseas grads follow the same China clock: early batch Jul–Aug, formal batch Sep–Oct, spring supplementary round.

tip.zh: 海外应届身份的认定（毕业时间、留服认证）要提前查清楚，很多岗位以此为硬门槛。
tip.en: Check how your graduation date maps to the '应届' status and the credential authentication early — many roles gate on it.

detail.zh: 大厂提前批不占正式批机会，能投就投。
detail.en: Early batches don't consume your formal-batch chance — apply if eligible.

detail.zh: 字节 / 腾讯 / 阿里 / 券商集中开放。简历用国内格式（含照片、政治面貌可选）。
detail.en: ByteDance / Tencent / Alibaba / brokerages open. Use a China-format resume.

detail.zh: 笔试通常在周末晚上，注意时差。技术面 3 轮 + HR 面。
detail.en: Written tests often on weekend evenings (mind the time zone); 3 technical rounds + HR.

detail.zh: 海外院校通常没有三方，签 offer letter 即可；注意违约条款。
detail.en: Overseas schools usually skip the tripartite agreement; read the offer's breach clause.

detail.zh: 岗位少但竞争也小，秋招没定的同学重点抓。
detail.en: Fewer roles, less competition — the fallback for anyone still unsigned.

intro.zh: 教职市场提前一年启动，秋季投递、春季面试。
intro.en: The faculty market runs a year ahead: apply in fall, interview in spring.

tip.zh: 推荐信要提前 2 个月和导师确认；research statement 请至少两位校友帮看。
tip.en: Confirm letters with advisors 2 months ahead; have at least two alumni read your research statement.

detail.zh: CV、research / teaching statement、job talk 初稿。
detail.en: CV, research & teaching statements, first job-talk draft.

detail.zh: 多数北美院校截止在 11 月；国内高校常年开放但年底集中。
detail.en: Most North American deadlines fall in November; Chinese universities recruit year-round with a year-end peak.

detail.zh: Zoom 初面后受邀访校，job talk 需在校友面前彩排。
detail.en: Zoom screens then campus visits; rehearse the job talk with alumni.

detail.zh: 启动经费、教学负担、配偶安置都可以谈。
detail.en: Startup package, teaching load and partner placement are all negotiable.
